title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) in April's chat, or tap More info and paste the request there, for a deep dive.

items.headline_md: **Europe bomb-threat wave** hits **14+** passenger flights
items.summary_md: A second wave this week forced diversions (including Aer Lingus Dublin–Rome to France’s Evreux base); the UK Transport Secretary called them malicious hoaxes, and completed checks found no explosives.

items.headline_md: Update: **Democrats** hold a midterm wave; **Trump** and **Vance** blame the **Iran** war
items.summary_md: DW (with AP/Reuters) projects House ≥237–139 and Senate 54–44; Trump said the Iran conflict was “worth it,” while Vance called the war “the reason we lost.”

items.headline_md: **IRGC**: three vessels catch fire in the **Strait of Hormuz**
items.summary_md: Via IRNA, Iran said a large tanker hit a mine on an “unauthorized route,” with a second supertanker and a tug also ablaze in separate incidents; the IRGC claimed continued control of the strait.

items.headline_md: **Yemen**: missile strike kills **13** recruits, wounds **65**
items.summary_md: A government official told Xinhua a ballistic missile hit a training center in Qatabah, Al-Dhalea, during morning exercises and blamed the Houthis.

items.headline_md: **AstraZeneca** makes a ~**$10B** offer for **Rhythm Pharmaceuticals**
items.summary_md: Reuters says the non-binding bid is up to about $134/share including milestones; Rhythm closed +28% at $110.68 (~$7.64B market cap).

items.headline_md: **China** blocks **SoftBank**’s **ABB** robotics deal
items.summary_md: ABB said China prohibited SoftBank’s acquisition of its robotics unit, agreed at a $5.375B enterprise value.

items.headline_md: **Qualcomm** beats, guides soft; stock **−7%** after hours
items.summary_md: Adj. EPS $2.17 and revenue $10.44B (−7% YoY); handset chips −26% to $5.14B while auto +89% to $1.99B; Q1 guide $10.4–$11.2B revenue.

items.headline_md: **Amazon** drops **Grubhub**, taps **Uber Eats** for Prime US delivery
items.summary_md: Prime members order Uber Eats via Amazon with no Uber account and free delivery over $25; Grubhub+ via Amazon ends today, with existing Grubhub+ usable through Dec 31, 2027.

items.headline_md: **Toyota** raises its earnings forecast; **Nintendo** H1 profit **+11%**
items.summary_md: Toyota lifted its outlook on a weaker yen and cost cuts; Nintendo’s H1 net profit was 220.92B yen (~$1.39B) on software and the new Mario movie.

items.headline_md: **God of War Laufey** delayed to **May 20, 2027**
items.summary_md: Sony Santa Monica pushed the PS5 exclusive from Feb 16 for polish; it’s the first mainline God of War without Kratos as lead.

items.headline_md: **Macronix** exits **Switch / Switch 2** cartridge ROM chips
items.summary_md: ROM fell to 5% of sales last quarter (from 26% a year earlier) as the firm shifts to NOR/eMMC, which could lift cartridge costs or push Game-Key Cards.

items.headline_md: Update: **Arkane Lyon** union says **Microsoft** “sabotaged” **Blade** then used delays to close the studio
items.summary_md: France’s STJV says a 19-month hiring freeze caused the delays Microsoft cited, and demands €200K (~$225K) redundancy per worker plus two years of redeployment support.

items.headline_md: Hyper-casual October: **Magic Sort** **9.1M** downloads; **Colony Flow** **$9.3M** IAP
items.summary_md: Magic Sort led downloads (+5% MoM); Colony Flow led IAP (~+37% MoM); Food Hunt hit 5.52M downloads (~+34% MoM).

items.headline_md: **Xbox Cloud Gaming** previews phone-as-controller and Nano Wi-Fi connect
items.summary_md: A Nov 4 preview lets phones drive supported smart TVs via browser controls, and US Xbox Nano Controllers can connect over Wi-Fi to cut lag.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: still no public repo or release from u/Mindstormman. Separate projects (CafeRecomp, nWiiURecomp) exist but aren’t that claim. Reddit’s r/decomps RSS timed out this run, so the subreddit wasn’t read directly. No credible PS5 or Switch 2 commercial-game emulator breakthrough in the last 24–48h.

items.headline_md: **ZeldaWWHDRecomp** drops a Nov 4 devel build (native PC Wind Waker HD)
items.summary_md: Stable is still v0.5.0 (Oct 29); `@735ce6b` adds Android save-transfer fixes, randomized USA TWWHD Randomizer setup, Steam Controller on macOS, GameCube HUD prompts, and more (Windows/macOS/Linux/Android; no game files shipped).

items.headline_md: **LAS Recomp** posts Beta 6 preview and snow test builds
items.summary_md: Latest regular release is still beta_5.4; Nov 3–4 test builds (test-beta6-preview, test-574-snow) are explicitly in-dev for issues #574/#575/#577, not general use.

items.headline_md: **shadPS4** v0.21.0 out Oct 30; Nov 5 pre-release landed
items.summary_md: “Until Mavethee Dawn” fixes platinum unlocks, texture cache, Rosetta 2 workarounds and USB/music HLE; pre-release `98ef621` published today.

items.headline_md: **PCSX2** 2.9.x nightlies continue through ~**2.9.155**
items.summary_md: Development builds only (no new stable); recent work includes Vulkan feedback-loop texture fixes.

items.headline_md: Domestic weekend (Oct 30–Nov 1): **You Can See Everything** **$11.4M** edges **Clayface** **$11.0M**
items.summary_md: A24’s 3-hour doc led a soft ~$62.2M overall frame (−38% WoW); Clayface cume $44.7M, Wildwood $8.9M / $27.4M cume.

items.headline_md: **You Can See Everything** scores **96%/96%** on Rotten Tomatoes
items.summary_md: 207 critic reviews and 2,500+ verified audience ratings; Clayface sits at 78% critics / 94% audience.

items.headline_md: Fri Nov 6: **Godzilla Minus Zero** tracking ~**$30M**; **Cat in the Hat** **$20–25M**
items.summary_md: Variety says Godzilla opens from 3,254 NA theaters (RT 89%); Cat in the Hat aims for ~4,000 venues on a $92M budget.

items.headline_md: **Resident Evil** still **$157.4M** domestic through week 7
items.summary_md: It added $2.6M last weekend; Other Mommy is at $55.7M domestic after week 4.

items.headline_md: Also opening Nov 6: **Wild Horse Nine** **$5–7M**, **Ramayana** ~**$6M** (4 days)
items.summary_md: Searchlight’s McDonagh film targets ~1,000 screens; Sony’s Ramayana aims for ~1,300 theaters, Variety’s widest NA Indian release call.

items.headline_md: **OpenAI** pledges to pay full data-center power costs after local votes
items.summary_md: CNBC: voters backed restrictions or rejected pro-development in 40 of 41 local measures across 10 states; OpenAI says owned DCs will pay full power, solicit input, and publish construction plans.

items.headline_md: **OpenAI** cyber pipeline finds **948** working Linux LPE PoCs in one run
items.summary_md: A mid-Oct run produced 2,308 candidates → 1,724 reproduced → 948 LPE PoCs plus 291 info-leak PoCs at ~$1.21M API cost (~$1,279 per LPE), with human review before reporting.

items.headline_md: **Meta** acquires AI coding startup **Conductor**
items.summary_md: Terms undisclosed; the cloud service shuts Nov 20 with cloud data deletion after, while local features continue into early 2027.

items.headline_md: **Meta** president: midterms make new data centers harder to build
items.summary_md: Dina Powell McCormick told the WSJ Tech conference the results will complicate greenfield builds, with more optimism about expanding existing sites.

items.headline_md: **AppLovin** crushes Q3; shares jump ~**20–25%**
items.summary_md: Revenue $2.18B (+55.5% YoY) and GAAP EPS $4.30; Q4 revenue guide midpoint $2.38B; stock closed +20.33% Wed at $326.99 and was +18% premarket Thu (~5:02 AM AZ).

items.headline_md: **Apple** lets apps show subscription retention offers on cancel
items.summary_md: Apps may surface value reminders and special-offer messages when users cancel subscriptions.

items.headline_md: **Discord** ditching Electron for a **Rust** desktop client
items.summary_md: CTO says Electron/React Native go away in favor of shared Rust with native mobile UI; a Windows screenshot showed ~290MB RAM vs often ≥1GB.

items.headline_md: **X** rolls out a faster rewritten web app country-by-country
items.summary_md: An engineer said profile load over a slow connection dropped from 22s to 2.7s to first post; logged-out/crawler views are already on the new stack.

items.headline_md: Wed close (post-midterm rally): **Dow +3.03%**, **S&P +1.58%**, **Nasdaq +1.44%**

items.summary_md: Yahoo’s early wrap shows AI/chip rotation overnight after the midterm rally.

items.headline_md: Asia chips slide: **Samsung** and **SK Hynix** both **>7%** down; Kospi **>5%**
items.summary_md: Bloomberg/AP: the Kospi sank more than 5% and Nikkei 225 nearly −2% as AI names sold off.
Bloomberg Thu quotes (via swissinfo); Wed Brent had closed near $98.70 (−4.73% at 9:15 AM AZ Wed per Anadolu).

items.headline_md: **Phoenix**: High **78°F** / Low **57°F**, sunny, PoP **0%**, no alerts
items.summary_md: Clear to mostly sunny through the day; overnight low near 57°F with 0% PoP tonight.

items.headline_md: **Show Low**: High **57°F** / Low **37°F**, sunny, PoP **0%** today / **5%** tonight, no alerts
items.summary_md: Sunny Thursday; overnight low near 37°F with a slight (5%) precip chance tonight.

items.headline_md: **Snowflake**: High **57°F** / Low **36°F**, sunny, PoP **0%** today / **2%** tonight, no alerts
items.summary_md: Sunny Thursday; overnight low near 36°F with a 2% precip chance tonight.

items.headline_md: **OpenAI**’s data-center power pledge after anti–DC local votes
items.summary_md: Worth reading because it ties the midterm shock (40 of 41 local measures against or restricting data-center expansion) to how Big AI will site, finance, and sell power costs—and helps explain today’s chip/AI rotation.
